uv: world-scale: u, v = metres / tile_size_m; v runs down the texture = along the grain; decal faces 3 mm off the stone tops and north faces

_w2.name: heavy
_w2.look: thick moss with dead leaves caught in it

used_on: Moss and lichen as separate alpha decal geometry laid on tops of stones, torii kasagi, lantern roofs and north faces: variety without a second UV set (decision 10)
normal_convention: DirectX (green = down), like the library; make_textures.GREEN_DX flips all
render: _ca alpha = coverage; renderFlags NoZWrite (jp_m_wall_grime / vanilla decal pattern). RGB is the material colour everywhere, so the palette mean is meaningful.
note: G1 decision 10: moss as a separate decal material.
fx3: 1024 px = 2 m irregular drifts (was 256 px = 0.5 m); uvwood flips + offsets each decal
